name: one_shot_tool_runner
description:
Single-call tool runner for simple operations.
Use for creating todos, reminders, calendar events, weather-at-place lookups, UI mute/unmute actions, and simple link peek/summarize actions in one step.
arguments_prompt:
one_shot_tool_runner arguments:
task: the user request
information: any extra context
Provide the task and any additional information needed for the one_shot_tool_runner.
